text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick ideaor next Wed: run a short "Sunburst" recognition pop-up during 4pm mingle. Small enamel pins + coffee cart. Who's in to help organize? :sparkles:
Ravi (HR): Pins sound great. Do we need to log these as spot awards or is this informal swag?
Maya (People Ops): Informal swag primarily. If managers want a cash conversion later, we can process via the spot-award budget (low-dollar exceptions).
Lena - Eng: How are nominees selected? Will this be manager-driven or open peer noms?
Maya (People Ops): Open peer nominations, 48hr window. One-line reason only. Keeps it lightweight.
Diego - Sales: I'll rally the sales floor. Can we make nomination anonymous? Some folks prefer that.
Ravi (HR): Recommend optional anonymity. Also keep a CSV export for audit. I'll approve the wording once we have the form.
Tess - Design: I can design a 11x17 poster and social slide for the all-hands feed. Also a tiny GIF for Slack.
Maya (People Ops): Perfect. Copy for the announcement: "Nominate a teammate for a Sunburst — tell us one quick example of how they helped or brightened your week. Nominations open 48hrs. We'll celebrate Wed 4pm with pins & coffee."
facilities-bot: Room booking confirmed: North lounge from 3:45-4:30. Tables: 2, power: yes.
Diego - Sales: Coffee cart — can we get oat milk and decaf? Also small cookies.
Maya (People Ops): We'll do vegan + gluten-free cookies. Olive from facilities can confirm catering order.
Tess - Design: Pin mock uploaded to the design board: sunny star enamel with a tiny Redwood leaf. Thoughts?
Lena - Eng: Love it. One thought: make sure distributed pins don't violate any procurement thresholds for gifts. Ravi?
Ravi (HR): I'll check the internal policy. Small swag under $50/person is usually fine for events; since it's not performance-based cash, we should be OK. I'll confirm by EOD.
kudos-bot: Auto: Alex nominated Priya for pairing on the onboarding doc yesterday! :tada:
Maya (People Ops): Volunteers: setup 3:45-4:00 (put out pins + table), emcee 4:00-4:10 (run 3 quick mic passes), teardown 4:20-4:30. Who can do setup?
Tess - Design: I'll do setup and emcee the design shoutouts.
Diego - Sales: I can handle emcee for sales shoutouts and help with teardown.
Lena - Eng: I'll take teardown.
Ravi (HR): Once pins are sorted, I'll send a short compliance note and keep a nominations sheet for records.
Maya (People Ops): Awesome. Final action items: Tess poster + gif by Tue noon, form live Tue 9am, facilities confirm snacks by Tue 11am, Ravi to confirm policy by EOD today. Thanks team!
notes: Sunburst recognition pop-up; enamel pin swag; open peer nominations 48hrs; volunteers and catering needs; compliance check
